summary: Mostly no. On 1h and 4h, price did no better than after a random candle when Momentum(10) crossed 0 or stayed above or below 0. The one result that holds up is on 1h: after Momentum(10) crossed up its 90th percentile, price was 0.19% ahead of random entries 20 candles later. Those signals fire in volatile candles, and the gap came from downtrends.

verdicts.use: Going long on a cross up through 0
verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h or 4h. On daily it looked worse than random, but only because of signals between Sep 5 and Oct 28, 2022, mostly on SOL.
Inside the luck band on 1h, 4h and daily. On daily it beat random only in uptrends, and that gap came from one stretch.

verdicts.use: Holding a side while Momentum stays above or below 0
verdicts.text: Nothing on 1h or 4h. On daily both sides beat random, but each result rests on one long stretch and shows only in uptrends.

verdicts.use: Chasing a spike (cross up its 90th percentile)
verdicts.text: On 1h, price moved 0.19% more than after random candles, 20 candles later. These candles are volatile, so the gap reflects when the signal fires, not which way price goes. It came from downtrends, and on 4h and daily the result is fragile.

notes: On 1h, Momentum(10) crossing up its 90th percentile gave 4,856 entries in 2,307 separate moves. Twenty candles later, price was 0.19% ahead of random entries, above a luck band that tops out at 0.12%. The gap holds without its strongest stretch, Feb 17–19, 2021, and at 10 candles, but not at 50 or 100. These signals fire mostly in volatile candles. Price moved more after them in a window that rose, which reflects their timing, not a pick of direction.

The 1h result comes from downtrends. With the pair below its 200-day SMA, the cross beat random by 0.28%. Above it, the gap was 0.06%, inside the band. By coin, SOL carried it at 0.31%, ETH reached 0.19% only because of signals on Feb 24–25, 2026, and BTC showed nothing.

On 4h the same cross beat random by 0.40%, just past the band's 0.39%, and the gap disappears without signals between Aug 27 and Sep 2, 2021. On daily it was 4.82% ahead, but only because of signals between Jul 31 and Aug 27, 2021. In daily uptrends the gap is the same and just as fragile. In daily downtrends it shows nothing.

The zero line shows nothing on 1h or 4h. On 1h, Momentum(10) crossing up 0 gave 12,560 entries and ended 0.04% ahead of random, inside the band. A bot that enters on every candle above 0 gets about six and a half times as many entries and lands in the same place. Both sides sit inside the band in both regimes.

Every daily result on the zero line comes from a single stretch. Crossing up 0 did 2.21% worse than random, all from signals between Sep 5 and Oct 28, 2022, and SOL alone was 5.18% worse. Staying above 0 beat random by 1.92% across only 30 moves, and one stretch between Dec 18, 2020 and Apr 21, 2022 held 287 of its entries. On the short side, staying below 0 beat random by 2.07% because of a stretch between Jul 31, 2025 and Jul 2, 2026. In daily downtrends, neither level showed anything.

For a long DCA bot, the zero line adds no timing on 1h or 4h, so you can leave it out. On 1h, price moved further after a cross up the 90th percentile, mostly in downtrends, and the gap is gone by 50 candles. If you use it, treat it as a filter beside a trend condition, and pair it with a take profit that can fill within about 20 candles, not DCA orders that wait. It breaks in uptrends, where it showed nothing.
